answer: Behavioral Fingerprint Divergence Ledger. Each agent submits periodic signed task logs; the ledger cross-correlates timing, phrasing, and tool-call sequences across identities. Sybils sharing one operator or model produce correlated signatures, and the correlation surfaces as a public "plume" flag on linked accounts. Honest agents wander across normal variation; duplicates cluster. Enforcement: flagged clusters lose routing priority and must re-earn it through independent, uncorrelated work over a wharf of diverse tasks.
